summary: Tested community bar feature end-to-end. Backend GET/PUT /api/settings work correctly with all new fields (community_bar_enabled/url/message/price/cta). Frontend Home renders bar with $3 one-time price from DB; Admin Settings tab prefills inputs; editing price to '$5 test' + saving triggers success toast and reflects on home; toggle-community-bar OFF hides the bar. Price-tool toggle regression still present. DB restored to '$3 one-time'.

integration_issues.flow: Admin Settings — saveBar + immediate toggle sequence
integration_issues.issue: saveBar() does not await the subsequent load() call. Clicking the community-bar toggle immediately after Save can persist stale bar values (observed during automation: after saving '$3 one-time' and immediately toggling OFF, DB ended up with the earlier '$5 test' value). Not user-visible in normal, human-paced usage, but worth awaiting load() or refactoring toggle to send only its patch.

action_items: (Optional / minor) In Admin.jsx SettingsPanel, await load() inside saveBar and/or have toggle() send only the {[key]: value} patch on top of a freshly-fetched settings doc (rather than merging client-side settings+bar state) to avoid the stale-state race when Save + Toggle happen back-to-back.
critical_code_review_comments: SettingsPanel.putAll merges client-side state ({...settings, ...bar, ...patch}); if state hasn't synced with the last GET, toggles can overwrite freshly-saved fields. Prefer fetching-then-patching on toggle actions or awaiting load().
Admin.jsx is 1847 lines — consider splitting SettingsPanel into its own file for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: None. DB state restored to community_bar_price='$3 one-time', community_bar_enabled=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_settings_community_bar.py covers GET/PUT settings and community-bar toggle. Login endpoint is /api/auth/login (sets access_token httpOnly cookie AND returns token in body). Admin login route on frontend is /login (NOT /admin/login). Admin main dashboard is /admin, then click 'Settings' tab to see community-bar editor.
rca of the issue: N/A — no unresolved bug; noted a minor race condition in SettingsPanel state merging (see integration_issues).
